text.aria-label: Title text 'In the worst runs, all three arms miss the level by the same amount'

g.text: In the worst runs, all three arms miss the level by the same amount

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'The three Primary substations with the lowest labels, one forecast run each. Each run is picked by rule: the worst run by L3's quantile score over 72 hours. The rule is unfavourable to L3. Dashed line: observed demand. Solid line: median forecast. Dark band: 25th to 75th percentile. Light band: 5th to 95th percentile. R0c: no lagged power. L3: lagged power in the calibrator. L2c: in stage 1b. Seed 0 only. Lagged power uses ERA5 weather at past times (an upper bound).'
text.tspan: The three Primary substations with the lowest labels, one forecast run each.
Each run is picked by rule: the worst run by L3's quantile score over 72 hours. The rule is
Dashed line: observed demand. Solid line: median forecast.
Dark band: 25th to 75th percentile. Light band: 5th to 95th percentile.
R0c: no lagged power. L3: lagged power in the calibrator. L2c: in stage 1b.
Seed 0 only. Lagged power uses ERA5 weather at past times (an upper bound).
